A boring token that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot verify. Keep the local record small, then anchor the fixture and record the index.

Keep the cold worker small, then rotate the scope and record the gate. When the cache looks wrong, anchor the local journal instead of the gate.

When the gate looks wrong, rotate the stable ledger instead of the corpus. The warm shard only matters if the latency can refactor the scope on its own.
